rv.q: They are enough for each other, and reason enough to see this “Jenufa.”
With a cast like this, JENUFA can stand up there with the great ones.

That the highly touted production proved the most negligible part of the experience in no way detracted from the evening, which was musically and expressively as affecting as one will find at the Met this season, Jenůfa is great because it does what opera is designed to do, as well as it can be done.

cn.t: Critics hail this "Jenůfa" as a triumph, with Grigorian and Panikkar delivering fearless, ferocious performances. Janáček's masterwork finally gets the spotlight it deserves.
